IDEA000009.old: A genuine operator has stable action-before-result framing and low descriptive-only usage on held folios; opaque carrier controls lack that ordered signature.
IDEA000009.canonical: A genuine operator has stable action-before-result framing and low descriptive-only usage on held folios; opaque carrier controls lack this ordered signature.

IDEA000009.title: A process operator whole selects action modality

design.binding: independent action/result annotations across at least five physical folios, with structural tags kept separate from lexical translations
design.contrast: candidate occurrences in action/result fields versus matched descriptive and label fields, stratified by section
design.countermodel: The whole is a generic content carrier whose apparent action association is caused by section or position; ordered framing should disappear under matched controls.
design.mechanism: The whole contributes an action modality that licenses an ordered operation/result frame, not merely a topic or item name.
design.prediction: A genuine operator has stable action-before-result framing and low descriptive-only usage on held folios; opaque carrier controls lack this ordered signature.
design.related: GDT744/GDT745 channel audits; GDT805 context-role discriminator; those routes do not select an operator modality as the target question
design.scope: cached structural tags and admitted prose/label selectors; feasibility unknown until action and result tags are independently bound
design.unit: complete whole in a cached field with independently tagged action, object, and result slots

IDEA000010.title: Amount expressions attach to a measured entity

design.binding: independent amount and material/operation annotations on at least five physical folios, with no component glosses used as labels
design.contrast: candidate whole on the material-side slot versus operation-side slot, matched within section and line position
design.countermodel: Adjacency is a layout convention or all nearby wholes are interchangeable; side-specific attachment should not transfer beyond discovery folios.
design.mechanism: An amount expression selects a material/part argument in one ordered slot; operation words occupy a distinct neighboring slot.
design.prediction: The measured-entity candidate recurs with independent amount frames and material/part tags on held folios, while the operation rival predicts process slots instead.
design.related: GDT760 amount-expression attachment; GDT804 bracket-middle audit; this proposal makes measured-entity versus operation the explicit rival
design.scope: cached exact amount expressions and admitted structural fields; feasibility unknown until amount direction and material tags are independently fixed
design.unit: amount expression plus adjacent complete-whole field and its ordered neighbors

design.binding: independent source-target relation edges on five physical folios, with alternate readers retained
design.contrast: source-before/target-after order versus reversed and no-argument controls
design.countermodel: Order is layout or section convention; reversed fields are equally common after matching.
design.mechanism: The action selects ordered source and target roles.
design.prediction: At least 75% of held action fields preserve the source-before-target order, exceeding reversed controls by 20 points across five folios.
design.related: GDT311 operation-event choice; GDT386 relation-edge capacity; this is a bounded semantic order claim
design.scope: cached action fields; feasibility unknown until source/target bindings are independent of the proposed order
design.unit: complete action field with independently bound source and target candidates
